# Data Source: stripe_tax_id

A tax ID of your own account or of a customer.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "stripe_tax_id" "acme_vat" {
  id = stripe_tax_id.acme_vat.id
}
```

## Argument Reference

This data source supports the following arguments:

* `id` - (Required) The ID of the tax id to read.

## Attribute Reference

This data source exports the following attributes in addition to the arguments above:

* `country` - Two-letter ISO code representing the country of the tax ID.
* `created` - Time at which the object was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.
* `customer` - ID of the customer.
* `customer_account` - ID of the Account representing the customer.
* `livemode` - If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.
* `owner` - The account or customer the tax ID belongs to. Defaults to `owner[type]=self`. See [`owner`](#owner) below.
* `type` - Type of the tax ID, one of `ad_nrt`, `ae_trn`, `al_tin`, `am_tin`, `ao_tin`, `ar_cuit`, `au_abn`, `au_arn`, `aw_tin`, `az_tin`, `ba_tin`, `bb_tin`, `bd_bin`, `bf_ifu`, `bg_uic`, `bh_vat`, * `verification` - Tax ID verification information. See [`verification`](#verification) below.

<a id="owner"></a>
### `owner`

The `owner` attribute supports:

* `account` - The account being referenced when `type` is `account`.
* `application` - The Connect Application being referenced when `type` is `application`.
* `customer` - The customer being referenced when `type` is `customer`.
* `customer_account` - The Account representing the customer being referenced when `type` is `customer`.
* `type` - Type of owner referenced. Possible values: `account`, `application`, `customer`, `self`.

<a id="verification"></a>
### `verification`

The `verification` attribute supports:

* `status` - Verification status, one of `pending`, `verified`, `unverified`, or `unavailable`. Possible values: `pending`, `unavailable`, `unverified`, `verified`.
* `verified_address` - Verified address.
* `verified_name` - Verified name.
